data.text:
Akash Vishwakarma vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 6
November, 2024 
Author: Vipin Chandra Dixit
Bench: Vipin Chandra Dixit
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
? Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:173798-Db
Court No. - 40
Case :- Writ - C No. - 27173 of 2024 
Petitioner :- Akash Vishwakarma
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Chetan Chatterjee,Ran Vijay Singh 
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Shekhar B. Saraf,J.
Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
1. Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the parties. 
2.  This is a petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India wherein the writ petitioner is aggrieved by the order dated March 27, 2024 passed by Assistant Commissioner (Food)-II, Food Safety and Drugs Administration, Varanasi rejecting his application for grant of permission to run a hukka bar in the restaurant run by the petitioner. 
Akash Vishwakarma vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146891130/
1 3. Counsel appearing on behalf of the State-respondent has submitted that this kind of permission could not be granted by the Food Safety Department. In fact, the same would be granted by the District Magistrate. 
4. In light of the same, the petitioner is directed to add the concerned District Magistrate as a party to this writ petition during the course of the day. Since the State-respondent is already appearing in the matter, this matter is disposed of with the direction upon the petitioner to move an appropriate application before the District Magistrate within a period of seven days from date. In the event such an application is filed, the District Magistrate shall decide the said application within ten days by passing a reasoned order after granting an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner. 
Order Date :- 6.11.2024 Virendra  Akash Vishwakarma vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146891130/
